semiconductor_relevance: High — HAMAI Korea specializes in high-purity gas valves essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HAMAI Korea Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies high-pressure gas valves, including specialty gas valves, crucial for the semiconductor industry. With a strong production base in Korea, the company leverages nearly a century of expertise to deliver high-quality products at competitive prices.

regional_presence.Korea: HAMAI Korea has established a production base in Korea, a leading hub for the semiconductor industry.
